Monitoring: Look out for small, pale green or yellowish leaves that have brown necrotic tips.
Check for trees with sparse foliage with little leaf litter that exposes the fruit to sunscald.
Look out for for small, fibrous feeder roots that are black, brittle or dead from infection.
Diseased trees frequently have a heavy crop of small fruits and foliage remains dry even when the soil is wet.
Take action when symptoms appear on one tree.
